objects.text:
The Twig is rustling...

While waiting for Thistle to answer your call, you remember that he has not been feeling well.

dialogue.content: Hi! What's up!
dialogue.name: Thistle

dialogue.content: Hi!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Do you have finished the Aculi analyses already by any chance?
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Well, honestly I am struggling a little bit with it, but I think I can have it done by tomorrow!
dialogue.name: Thistle

dialogue.content: Okay, I will call you back then around that time!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Bye!
dialogue.name: Thistle

objects.text:
The Twig is rustling...

Thistle was fague about what he was struggling with. He promised to provide new analyses this day.

dialogue.content: [ Groans a little ] He.. Hello [Name]!
dialogue.name: Thistle

dialogue.content: That does not sound good...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Hi, how's everything going?
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Well to be honest...
dialogue.name: Thistle

dialogue.content: Remember that I missed some of Oakpaws' classes lately?
dialogue.name: Thistle

dialogue.content: Eheh...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Okay good... So I got some flower buds, which should have cured my stomach.
dialogue.name: Thistle

dialogue.content: But... Honestly they only made me feel worse...
dialogue.name: Thistle

dialogue.content: Oof, okay. I am sorry to hear that. No worries. I will do the Aculi analyses instead!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Okay, thanks!
dialogue.name: Thistle

dialogue.content: Hopefully your better soon! But take your time!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Thanks! Bye.
dialogue.name: Thistle

objects.text:
The Twig is rustling...

Scrat takes his time to answer the call. You hope he has the list of Quercus trees ready.

dialogue.content: Hopefully he left the Acorn Ale aside since last time.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Yoo man! How are you doing!
dialogue.name: Scrat

dialogue.content: Hi! Busy with the harvest plan!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Do you by any chance have already had a look at the list of Quercus trees?
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Well you know, I first started by reading the Acorn Directive. Listened to Flicktail for once.
dialogue.name: Scrat

dialogue.content: So...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I... have indentified the places were they grow. I will finilize the list this afternoon. I understand that they're important for the harvest plan.
dialogue.name: Scrat

dialogue.content: Okay, I will call you back tomorrow if I don't have them by then, if that's okay.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Yeah sure! See ya.
dialogue.name: Scrat

dialogue.content: Really [Name]?! First you talk to me like Elder Oakpaw, and now you can't wait for me to bring some stuff.
dialogue.name: Scrat

dialogue.content: Which means that you haven't done anything yet?
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: As YOU said, I first started by reading the Acorn Directive. I think I will have the list done by tomorrow.
dialogue.name: Scrat

dialogue.content: Okay, I will call you back tomorrow if I don't have them by then, if that's okay.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Still not that patient, is it?! But sure. See ya.
dialogue.name: Scrat

objects.text:
The Twig is rustling...

Scrat again takes his time to answer the call.

dialogue.content: I hope that he has something done. Days pass by way to quickly.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: He ignores the Chatter Twig.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I better contact Flicktail about both the Aculi analysis and Scrat's behaviour.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I better contact Thistle first about the characters. Afterwards I should contact Flicktail.
dialogue.name: You

objects.text:
Meeting with Flicktail

You've updated Flicktail about the harvest plan and the problems you encountered.

dialogue.content: So we're missing two team members now...
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: And two quite big tasks left to be done.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Rotten Acorns! I mean Thistle can't do anything about it, but Scrat!
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: So what are we going to do about this?
dialogue.name: Flicktail

answer_options.content: [ Contact Elder Oakpaw and redevide tasks ]

objects.text:
Meeting with Flicktail

You've updated Flicktail about the harvest plan and the problems you encountered.

dialogue.content: Yeah that's probably the best...
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: I will try to list most of the Quercus trees and also write a report about it.
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: That would be great!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: If you have time, can you list also a few trees? And do the left over Aculi analyses?
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: I will see what I can do...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I will try to setup a meeting with Elder Oakpaw before dusk. I will call you as soon as we are ready.
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: If anything goes wrong, we should probably tell Elder Oakpaw about the problems.
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: Yeah sure!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I think we're set for now! See ya later.
dialogue.name: Flicktail

objects.text:
Conference with Flicktail and Elder Oakpaw

Elder Oakpaw is made aware of the situation. Hopefully he will be able to help.

dialogue.content: Sorry, that I am later. I had still some other stuff to do.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Haha, that's okay. I've already outlined the situation. So...
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: Sorry, that I am later. I had still some other stuff to do.
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: Haha, that's okay. I've already outlined the situation. So...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: It's a nasty situation to encounter. I feel sorry for that.
dialogue.name: Elder Oakpaw

dialogue.content: We can do several things.
dialogue.name: Elder Oakpaw

dialogue.content: I will give some extra time and I will drop the one-try rule for this extra promotion trajectory.
dialogue.name: Elder Oakpaw

dialogue.content: The later means that in a worst case scenario, you at least can retry to get this extra promotion next year.
dialogue.name: Elder Oakpaw

dialogue.content: Okay, yeah that would eliviate at least some pressure in the long term.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: That would help indeed!
dialogue.name: Flicktail

dialogue.content: Okay, best of luck with everything! Bye.
dialogue.name: Elder Oakpaw

dialogue.content: Thank you! Bye.
dialogue.name: Flicktail

objects.text:
Just before harvest time.

Willaferna surprises you on the Quercus tree hill.

dialogue.content: [ Hugs you from behind while your studying your harvest plan ]
dialogue.name: Willaferna

dialogue.content: Surprise! Surprise! How's everything going?
dialogue.name: Willaferna

dialogue.content: Well, luckily this extra project is not nessecary to get the regular promotion.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: And that promotion, is the most important think, right?!
dialogue.name: Willaferna

dialogue.content: So the Nest Broker called today and proposed that we come to have look at our nestling nook just before harvest time.
dialogue.name: Willaferna

dialogue.content: Can you free some time for that?
dialogue.name: Willaferna

dialogue.content: You had to talk to the Elders about a new role, isn't it?
dialogue.name: Willaferna

dialogue.content: Do you have still time for that?
dialogue.name: Willaferna

answer_options.content: [ Do not go to the role interview ]

dialogue.content: You had the application for your next promotion planned this cycle right?
dialogue.name: Willaferna

dialogue.content: Do you have still time for that?
dialogue.name: Willaferna

answer_options.content: [ Do not apply for your next promotion ]
